{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Tests

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    tags: ["*"]
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:
  schedule:
    # Rerun CI in order to detect flaky tests. Note that all packages are pinned, so
    # these scheduled runs are unaffected by upstream releases.
    # The upstream.yml workflow will instead pick up upstream changes.
    - cron: "0 6,18 * * *"

# When this workflow is queued, automatically cancel any previous running
# or pending jobs from the same branch
concurrency:
  group: tests-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  test:
    # Do not run the schedule job on forks
    if: github.repository == 'dask/dask' || github.event_name != 'schedule'

    # If you change the pattern of this name, please adjust
    # ../distributed/continuous_integration/scripts/test_report.py accordingly
    name: ${{ matrix.os }} ${{ matrix.environment }} ${{ matrix.task }}
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 60
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        # Note: after adding/removing builds here, update
        # codecov.yml to match.
        os: [ubuntu-latest, ubuntu-24.04-arm, windows-latest]
        environment: [py310, py311, py312, py313, py314, py315]
        task: [test-ci]
        include:
          # MacOS CI does not have many hosts available; run it only once
          - os: macos-latest
            environment: py315
            task: test-ci
          # Minimum dependencies
          - os: ubuntu-latest
            environment: mindeps-array
            task: test-ci
          - os: ubuntu-latest
            environment: mindeps-dataframe
            task: test-ci
          - os: ubuntu-latest
            environment: mindeps-distributed
            task: test-ci
          - os: ubuntu-latest
            environment: mindeps-non-optional
            task: test-ci
          - os: ubuntu-latest
            environment: mindeps-optional
            task: test-ci
          # Experimental setups
          - os: ubuntu-latest
            environment: py315
            task: test-array-expr
          - os: ubuntu-latest
            environment: mindeps-array
            task: test-array-expr
          - os: ubuntu-latest
            environment: py314t
            task: test-ci
          - os: ubuntu-latest
            environment: py315t
            task: test-ci
          - os: ubuntu-latest
            environment: spark
            task: test-spark

    steps:
      - name: Checkout source
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0  # Needed by codecov.io

      - name: Reconfigure pytest-timeout
        # No SIGALRM available on Windows
        # Note: all changes to the source code must happen before setup-pixi
        # or we'll build the package twice
        if: ${{ matrix.os != 'windows-latest' }}
        run: sed -i.bak 's/timeout_method = "thread"/timeout_method = "signal"/' pyproject.toml

      - uses: prefix-dev/setup-pixi@v0.11.3
        with:
          pixi-version: v0.85.0
          environments: ${{ matrix.environment }}
          cache: true
          locked: true

      - name: Run tests
        id: run_tests
        run: pixi run -e ${{ matrix.environment }} ${{ matrix.task }}
  
      - name: Coverage
        uses: codecov/codecov-action@v7
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}

      - name: Upload test results
        # ensure this runs even if pytest fails
        if: >
          always() &&
          (steps.run_tests.outcome == 'success' || steps.run_tests.outcome == 'failure')
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: ${{ matrix.os }}-${{ matrix.environment }}-${{ matrix.task }}
          path: pytest.xml

  # Publish an artifact for the event; used by publish-test-results.yaml
  event_file:
    # Do not run the schedule job on forks
    if: github.repository == 'dask/dask' || github.event_name != 'schedule'
    name: "Event File"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Upload
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: Event File
          path: ${{ github.event_path }}",
  "rationale": "The test job currently has a 90-minute timeout, but historical successful runs (e.g., run 45872647765: 35 minutes, run 45827012873: 33 minutes) complete in ~35 minutes. Reducing the timeout to 60 minutes provides ample operational headroom while bounding runaway job consumption. This aligns with pattern P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT, which shows measured elapsed savings of 26.8% in a comparable experiment (experiment:batch-interactive-three--fb8b16eb65a11508) and estimated VM time reductions of 12.9% (free) / 8.1% (paid). The change preserves all test coverage and matrix configurations.",
  "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-interactive-three--fb8b16eb65a11508", "pattern:P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT"]
}
